text:
Ana: quick sync — we need a final cutlist to protect MVP launch next month. short options.
Devon: go.
Ana: Proposal: MVP = runtime + API + basic model pinning (API + CLI) + simple canary toggle in console. Cut: full pin-management UI, advanced tag filters, embeddings dashboard, long-retention route telemetry, and eval automation.
Kai: +1. Frontend time for full pin UI is the main blocker.
Raj: pilots care about rollback speed. can we ensure rollback endpoint + CLI that hits audit logs?
Devon: yes: POST /api/v1/pins/rollback + CLI wrapper. add logging header: X-Request-ID + actor. ~4 dev-days.
Marie: UX: include a small header in console showing the current pinned model and link to "pin rollback" docs so pilots see it. tiny copy.
Ana: Can we keep canary core and just add a toggle + percentage slider? advanced flows to v1.
Devon: canary core exists server-side; UI toggle = ~2 dev-days, safety tests = ~5 dev-days.
Kai: I'll run a rollback runbook to prove <3m rollback and <500ms added latency on canary.
Raj: pinging pilots now: @acme_pilot @greenleaf_pilot — will surface objections.
release-bot: note: milestone freeze in 7 business days. last build cutoff: 2781239000.
Ana: action items: Devon confirm final estimates by EOD; Kai run SLA validation; Marie draft header + CLI doc; Raj get pilot buy-in. I'll update milestone tracker.
Devon: estimate total ~13 dev-days for MVP-facing work (CLI + toggle + rollback + logs) assuming FE cuts.
Marie: small note — header must state "pinned models are global to tenant" to avoid confusion.
Ana: agreed. locking scope tomorrow unless pilots push back.
